_note: PLACEHOLDER seed data, not team-curated. Episode Generator PRD calls for 'samples and suggestions generated by the team for common interest clusters' — no team was available to curate this in this session, so these are a reasonable starter seed_request_text per existing Onboarding interest tag (app/data/onboarding_seeds.json), written so the shared-inventory pipeline (app/services/episode_generator.generate_shared_episode, POST /internal/generate-shared-inventory) has something real to run end-to-end. Replace with actual team-curated requests before relying on this for real customer-facing content. `tag` values must exactly match an `id` in onboarding_seeds.json's `interests` list, since Home matches a customer's selected_interests against these tags verbatim.
